text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, mesalamine extended-release capsules are on the FDA shortage list with a status of To Be Discontinued. Corvale East holds 49 units (5.5 days supply), Corvale General holds 163 units (17 days supply), and Corvale Lakeside holds 50 units (27.4 days supply). All sites use NDC 70771162507 labeled by Zydus Lifesciences Limited (SPL set ID 04073681-a834-4f45-91c5-224b608b30e6).

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list records Mylan Pharmaceuticals Inc. posting a discontinuation on 2026-08-25 and Takeda Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. posting a discontinuation on 2026-09-16. The Zydus manufacturing site (FEI 3007938603) shows only Voluntary Action Indicated inspections from 2015 through 2023-03-24 with no Official Action Indicated classifications in FDA's posted records.

Our position: The FDA shortage list cites manufacturer discontinuations by Mylan and Takeda, not Zydus-specific actions. Zydus inspection records show only VAI findings. We must verify whether Zydus supply allocations are changing and confirm any inter-site transfer with both pharmacy managers.

Recommended actions:
1. Verify Zydus allocation status with the manufacturer — buyer.
2. Transfer 24 units from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East — pharmacy director (transfer request) and both pharmacy managers.
3. Transfer 28 units from Corvale General to Corvale East — pharmacy director (transfer request) and both pharmacy managers.
4. Evaluate purchase from Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc. — buyer.
5. Evaluate purchase from Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited — buyer.
6. Evaluate purchase from American Health Packaging — buyer.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing or therapeutic alternative recommendations; those decisions belong to treating clinicians and the committee.
